svg.title: A run stops before the external boundary
svg.desc: End the run's action line before the external perimeter. Preserve a visible gap, making the initial stop a concrete behavior rather than a caption-only hesitation. Visual distinction: A continuous double rule with permission tabs on only one side. Marks allowed scope independently of technical ability; never implies a physical wall.
